criteria.criterion: Exactly six complete object groups occupy a 3-column by 2-row layout in the specified order; no other objects.
The background is uniform saturated magenta, with generous empty margins around each group and no visible grid/floor/platform/cast shadow.
Every object and strap/temple/cord/sole/finger is fully visible and lies entirely within its own cell; groups never touch.
Coherent rounded cartoon-like 3D with credible leather/fabric/rubber/plastic, matching the provided reference rather than photographic product shots.
Top-left has a complete pair of sturdy brown ankle work boots with both soles.
Top-centre has folded long-sleeve green shirt and tan trousers together; top-right has a broad-brim beige hat and complete cord.
Bottom-left has two intact beige woven gardening gloves.
Bottom-centre sealed-rim splash goggles and bottom-right open-sided safety spectacles are visibly different, with neutral lenses and intact straps/temples.
No lettering, number, logo, watermark, arrow or tick mark.
No people, faces, mannequins, hands or body parts.

compositorGate: Actual pixels and magenta-keyed motion frames/playback must pass; automated sprite QA is not final acceptance.
